name: tc-netem-netem-delay-policy-drop-with-accept
description: netem-delay with a policy-drop chain with the peer already accepted
setup: nft add chain inet f out "{ type filter hook output priority 0; policy drop; }"
nft add rule inet f out ip daddr 10.5.5.2 accept

action.spec: tc qdisc add dev veth0 root netem delay 100ms
